findings.summary: 5 sample(s) lost their data in protein_rppa.tsv.gz. Affected samples by release-A labels: subtype: 5 Her2; ER: 3 Negative, 1 Positive. All 5 are Her2, a subtype that is 7.0% of labelled samples in release A; by chance that would happen about 1 time in 591,446, so this change hit one subgroup. Questions that count or compare subtypes are hit hardest. The total sample count in protein_rppa.tsv.gz is unchanged (747), so a count check would miss this. Samples: TCGA-A8-A08J-01, TCGA-C8-A12Q-01, TCGA-C8-A26Y-01, TCGA-E9-A1RH-01, TCGA-GM-A2DH-01.
